title: Analyzing the Relationship Between Sleep Habits and GPA for First-Year College Students
text:
The question
We’re interested in creating a model that will help students understand what sleep habits are associated with higher or lower end-of-term GPA for a first-year university student. In addition to studying total sleep time, we wanted to look at other sleep habit variables such as when students are going to bed (average bedtime) and how much they’re sleeping in the day and how that is associated with GPA. In addition, we wanted to examine the relationship between gender, sleep habits, and GPA to see whether the association between sleep habits and GPA differed by gender.
Our data source is from a study that tracked sleep data and GPA for first-year students at Carnegie Mellon, Notre Dame, and the University of Washington. One limitation is that the data did not come from a random sample of college students, so it may not be representative of the whole population.
